preamble.title: Key Derivation Methods for Stellar Keys
preamble.author: SDF

summary: This Stellar Ecosystem Proposal describes methods for key derivation for Stellar. This should improve key storage and moving keys between wallets and apps.

fields.name: mnemonic_to_seed
fields.description: Convert mnemonic to 64-byte BIP-39 seed using PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 with 2048 iterations

fields.name: passphrase_support
fields.description: Support optional passphrase for additional security in seed derivation

fields.name: stellar_derivation_path
fields.description: Stellar-specific derivation path m/44'/148'/x' where 44' is BIP-44 purpose and 148' is Stellar coin type

fields.name: hardened_derivation
fields.description: All derivation indices must be hardened (index + 2^31) for Ed25519

fields.name: ed25519_master_key_generation
fields.description: Generate master key using HMAC-SHA512(key='ed25519 seed', data=BIP39_seed)

fields.name: ed25519_child_key_derivation
fields.description: Derive child keys using HMAC-SHA512(key=parent_chain_code, data=0x00||parent_key||index+2^31)

fields.name: get_keypair
fields.description: Get full Stellar KeyPair (public and private key) at specified derivation index

fields.name: get_account_id
fields.description: Get Stellar account ID (G... address) at specified derivation index

fields.name: get_public_key
fields.description: Get raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key at specified derivation index

fields.name: get_private_key
fields.description: Get raw 32-byte Ed25519 private key at specified derivation index
